name: Meilisearch
description: A search engine for applications: fast, typo-tolerant, with an API applications call directly. The master key is generated here; derive per-app keys from it inside Meilisearch.

access.note: Nothing here signs in through a browser: this blueprint sets MEILI_ENV=production, which switches off Meilisearch's built-in search preview, so the address answers {"status":"Meilisearch is running"} and nothing else. Applications authenticate by sending the generated master key as an "Authorization: Bearer <key>" header — use it once against /keys to mint a narrower key per application.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Public domain
inputs.description: Optional; applications on this host reach it over the Docker network without one.

update.notes: Meilisearch's index format changes between minor versions and needs a dump-and-restore across them.
